pr_title: Fix live bindings and `this` of external CommonJS modules
pr_body:
Fixes #6241. Fixes T-1057.

Makes external CJS modules always use property lookups rather than destructuring the imported symbols. This ensures live bindings work properly, and also that `this` references are correct.

issue_context.title: Scope hoisting replaces `obj.hasOwnProperty` with `hasOwnProperty`
issue_context.body:
# 🐛 bug report

Scope hoisting replaces `obj.hasOwnProperty` with `hasOwnProperty`. This results in the following error:

The error:
```js
TypeError: Cannot convert undefined or null to object
    at hasOwnProperty (<anonymous>)
```

I hit this in Node-graceful-fs although it will be fixed in:
https://github.com/isaacs/node-graceful-fs/pull/206

Here is the minimal reproduction:
```js
const constants = require('constants')

console.log(constants.hasOwnProperty('O_SYMLINK'))

```
Gives:
```js
var hasOwnProperty = require("constants").hasOwnProperty;
console.log(hasOwnProperty('O_SYMLINK'));

//# sourceMappingURL=a.js.map
```


## 🎛 Configuration (.babelrc, package.json, cli command)

```js
{
  "test": "./a.js",
  "scripts" : {
    "build":  "parcel build --no-optimize --target test ./a.source.js"
  },
  "targets": {
    "test": {
      "context": "node"
    }
  }
}
```

## 🤔 Expected Behavior

Keep the `obj.`

## 😯 Current Behavior

Removes `obj.`
<!--- Tell us what happens instead of the expected behavior -->

<!--- If you are seeing an error, please include the full error message and stack trace -->

## 💁 Possible Solution

1. Don't use scope hoisting for now.
2. Don't bundle fs-graceful
